name: ONDC (Open Network for Digital Commerce)
notes: Section 8 non-profit, govt-backed; extends Beckn Protocol for commerce/mobility/logistics/finance.

name: eGov Foundation / DIGIT
notes: Open-source platform for local governance; certified Digital Public Good.

name: MOSIP (Modular Open Source Identity Platform)
notes: Originated at IIIT-Bangalore; Infosys TechForGood contributes modules. Adopted 10+ countries.

name: Infosys Springboard
notes: Open-source digital skilling platform, Infosys Foundation.

name: UNICEF / Nyaruka (RapidPro)
notes: Used in several India state govt programs.

name: OpenSPP community
notes: Social protection / benefit delivery platform.

name: Medic (Community Health Toolkit)
notes: Offline-first frontline health worker platform.

name: Mojaloop Foundation
notes: Gates Foundation-backed open payment switch reference implementation.

name: MeitY — API Setu
notes: Govt of India open API aggregator/directory.

name: ISRO/NRSC — Bhuvan
notes: India's own satellite/geospatial data platform. Functional, sparsely documented.

name: CDPG — India Urban Data Exchange (IUDX)
notes: MeitY/Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs backed; open source, IISc Bangalore CDPG.

name: Bhashini (National Language Technology Mission)
notes: Open-source ASR/MT/TTS across Indian languages.

name: data.gov.in (Open Government Data Platform India)
notes: MeitY open-data catalogue; per-dataset freshness varies widely.

name: Sunbird
notes: India-origin education infrastructure stack; underlies DIKSHA.

name: OpenCRVS community
notes: Open-source civil registration (births/deaths).

name: Apache Fineract / Mifos Initiative
notes: Open-source core banking for microfinance/financial inclusion.

name: ODK (Open Data Kit)
notes: Offline-first mobile data collection framework.

name: KoboToolbox
notes: Form-based data collection for humanitarian/research use.

name: OpenMRS / Bahmni
notes: Open-source EMR; Bahmni is India-origin (Thoughtworks + collaborators).

name: Primero / CPIMS+ (UNICEF-backed)
notes: Open-source child-protection case management.

name: OpenClimate
notes: Open climate/emissions-accounting tracking platform.

name: SEPAL (FAO)
notes: Cloud platform for satellite land-monitoring.

name: X-Road (Estonia-origin, reused elsewhere)
notes: Secure gov-to-gov data exchange layer; architectural reference, not India-deployed.

name: TCS (Public Services India / DigiGOV)
notes: System integrator for govt mission-mode programs (GeM, passports, pensions). Not a public-good API itself.

name: Wipro Foundation
notes: CSR programs; not a software/API platform.

name: UIDAI (Aadhaar)
notes: Statutory authority issuing India's biometric digital identity (~144 crore numbers issued). Access is tiered and permissioned, not open — see individual capability rows.

name: NPCI (UPI)
notes: Section 8 non-profit operating India's real-time payments switch. ~20 billion monthly transactions as of early 2026. API access is via licensed PSP/bank, not direct public integration.

name: MeitY (DigiLocker)
notes: Cloud document wallet + verified-issuer document exchange. Requester API needs MeitY approval; citizen-facing app usable directly.

name: Sahamati (Account Aggregator ecosystem)
notes: Industry alliance coordinating the RBI-regulated Account Aggregator (AA) consent framework for financial-data sharing. Technical specs maintained by ReBIT. Direct AA data access requires FIU status (regulated entity) or a partnership with one.

name: National Health Authority (ABDM)
notes: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission — health-records layer of India Stack: health ID, facility/practitioner registries, consent-based health record exchange.
